defects.description: Math.round chooses the integer toward positive infinity at negative ties instead of the contracted away-from-zero result.
defects.why_missed: S9(d): the familiar JavaScript rounding oracle says -2, but the signed monetary contract requires -3; positive ties and negative non-ties do not distinguish them.

defects.description: Tax is computed on absolute net, making credits carry a charge rather than reverse the signed tax.
defects.why_missed: S9(d): treating tax as an unsigned payable amount makes +200 look reasonable, but the credit contract requires reversing it to -200; an integral tax isolates this from rounding.
